page_title: CRE 0-2 ACM | Cremonese v AC Milan 01/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+4' 0 - 2 Goal! Christopher Nkunku shows great vision to find Rafael Leao (AC Milan) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
90+2' Referee Davide Massa signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the AC Milan players have a reason to celebrate!
90+1' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The AC Milan players aren’t happy.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' 0 - 1 Goal! Koni De Winter picks out Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the top right corner with a header from close range. 0:1.
89' It will be a substitution. Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) is ready to enter the pitch as Davide Bartesaghi walks off.
89' Luka Modric (AC Milan) is about to take a corner kick.

88' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to AC Milan.
86' A decent cross gives Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range.
86' Luka Modric (AC Milan) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
86' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared. The referee blows his whistle, AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
85' Davide Massa shows the yellow card to Youssef Maleh (Cremonese) for a heavy challenge.
84' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese).
83' Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
82' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
82' Substitution. Jari Vandeputte makes way for Alberto Grassi (Cremonese).

80' Sebastiano Luperto (Cremonese) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the roof of the net, but Mike Maignan pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
78' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Zachary Athekame (AC Milan) replacing Fikayo Tomori.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) is coming onto the pitch as Christian Pulisic cannot continue after picking up an injury.
78' Referee Davide Massa signals NO PENALTY for AC Milan after a VAR review!

78' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Cremonese.

77' Luka Modric (AC Milan) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
76' Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Davide Massa ignores the protests.
75' The game is pretty dull as Cremonese are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
74' A pass finds the feet of Rafael Leao (AC Milan) on the edge of the box and he sends in a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's easily gathered by the goalkeeper.
73' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his low effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Emil Audero.
71' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Davide Massa who sees an offensive foul.
70' AC Milan are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
68' Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
68' Half-chance! Rafael Leao (AC Milan) plays a pass into the box, but Emil Audero reacts well to snuff out the attack.
66' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) replaces Alessio Zerbin.
66' Jamie Vardy comes off the pitch to be replaced by Milan Djuric (Cremonese).
66' Here comes a substitution. Matteo Bianchetti is given a rest as he is replaced by Filippo Terracciano (Cremonese).
65' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
64' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Davide Massa stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
63' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
62' Massimiliano Allegri prepares a substitution. Alexis Saelemaekers is replaced by Niclas Fullkrug (AC Milan).
62' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Youssouf Fofana walks off the pitch to be replaced by Samuele Ricci (AC Milan).
60' Chance! Rafael Leao (AC Milan) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Adrien Rabiot, but his shot from inside the box flashes just over the bar.

60' Francesco Folino (Cremonese) latches on to the corner kick and releases a quick strike from the edge of the box. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way over the crossbar.
59' Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
58' Cremonese take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
58' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese have been awarded a corner kick.
56' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
54' 4:5 – the corner kicks stats.
51' A pass lands at the feet of Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
51' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
50' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
49' The Cremonese players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
48' Davide Massa blows his whistle and it's Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
46' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) plays a one-two with Rafael Leao, but the move breaks down.
46' Referee Davide Massa blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Luka Modric (AC Milan) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

45+1' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Emil Audero thwarts him with a great two-handed save. The ball is out of play. AC Milan will have a chance to score from a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) is quickest inside the box and leaps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it floats just over the crossbar.
45' Corner kick. Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) is ready to send the ball into the box.
44' Youssouf Fofana plays a lovely pass into Christian Pulisic (AC Milan), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post.
44' A pass from Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is intercepted by Emil Audero and the move breaks down.
43' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
43' Luka Modric (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
42' It will be a corner kick for AC Milan.
41' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) is penalised for a foul. Davide Massa had a clear view and blows his whistle.
40' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) who sends his header well wide of the right post.
37' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

36' Morten Thorsby (Cremonese) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the bottom right corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Mike Maignan pulls off an easy save.

34' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
32' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) commits a foul and Davide Massa immediately signals a free kick.
30' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
30' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
29' Luka Modric (AC Milan) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
29' AC Milan are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.

27' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the right post.
26' Corner kick. Cremonese will have an opportunity.
25' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

24' What a great touch by Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) as he controls a fine pass into the box and fires the ball to the left post, but the effort is brilliantly blocked. AC Milan will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
23' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
20' Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
18' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) jumps into a tackle and Davide Massa signals a foul.
17' Sebastiano Luperto (Cremonese) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is out of play. AC Milan will take a throw-in.

16' AC Milan are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
15' A cross from Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
14' Cremonese keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
13' A long pass, executed by Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
11' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
11' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
10' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The linesman makes the right call and AC Milan will have a corner.
9' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
7' Good work from Cremonese as they win a corner.
6' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. Cremonese win a corner.
6' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) prepares to take a corner kick.
6' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Cremonese.
5' Mike Maignan leaps to intercept the corner kick from Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese).
4' The cross into the penalty area from Youssef Maleh (Cremonese) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. AC Milan will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Davide Massa.
